question: Should ACP numeric `timeoutSeconds` patches preserve fractional-value rounding, or intentionally adopt integer-only validation for existing callers?
rationale: The branch changes accepted runtime input behavior, and the prior review already identified this as a compatibility decision rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Preserve current rounding
options.body: Keep accepting fractional numeric patches and round them until a separately approved ACP contract change establishes integer-only input.

options.title: Adopt integer-only input
options.body: Approve rejection of fractions, document the intended compatibility boundary, and rebase the test onto the current ACP runtime-options suite.

recommendation.title: Preserve current rounding
recommendation.body: Keep accepting fractional numeric patches and round them until a separately approved ACP contract change establishes integer-only input.
